thread:
maria: Heads-up — we're scheduled to swap the dedicated slice policy on the aurora pool tonight at 23:30 UTC. Goal: reduce min-scale for low-priority slices and enable burst gating. Who's owning the deploy?

kyle: I can own the deploy and smoke. I'll be online from 22:45 UTC. ping me if anything blocks.

ash: thanks. can you run the smoke checklist in staging first? I left a quick runbook in the PR.

jen: PR is up: https://git.internal/redwood/pool-policy/pull/487 — code review + tests passed. small config diff: 
```yaml
- min_scale: 2
+ min_scale: 1
- burst_window: 300
+ burst_window: 120
```

liam: what's our rollback play if latency SLOs spike? thresholds?

ash: rollback plan: 
- flip policy back to previous version via the policy-ops job (takes ~30s)
- revert pool config in k8s (immediate)
- fail traffic to fallback slice (automated)
- paging: @oncall if 3min p95 > 300ms for 2 consecutive 1min windows

maria: metrics to watch during smoke: p95 latency (inference), GPU utilization, queue depth, error rate. I put a dashboard link in the PR description. Also watch the routing logs for evictions.

kyle: smoke checklist I'll run (quick notes):
- staging policy apply (apply job) -> confirm pods become 1 less per slice
- run 1k QPS synthetic for 5m on canary model
- observe p50/p95 and queue depth
- tail logs: allocator and autoscaler
- run `kubectl get pods -n dedicated -l slice=aurora -o wide` to validate spread

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by kyle for 2026-03-18T23:30:00Z. Job ID: deploy-20260318-aurora-01.

jen: small note — the quota reservation TTL was reduced to 60s in this change. That might increase evictions for bursty short jobs. Watch eviction-rate metric `dedicated.pool.evictions_per_min`.

liam: I'll be ready to trigger rollback if p95 > 300ms or evictions_per_min > 5 sustained for 2 min. Also have a staged plan to drain the slice if needed.

ash: ownerships: kyle = deploy + smoke, liam = rollback lead, maria = monitoring + stakeholder updates, jen = PR author/support.

maria: Ack. kyle — can you post short smoke results in this thread within 15m after deploy? If smoke is green we'll leave config for 4 hours and then monitor overnight.

kyle: yep. if I see anything weird I'll revert immediately and call out the reason. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all. leaving a reminder on the calendar for 23:00 UTC check-in. good luck.

kyle: quick pre-check — infra quota for aurora has 10% headroom, verified. starting staging smoke at 23:00.

deploy-bot: deploy started: deploy-20260318-aurora-01 at 2026-03-18T23:30:02Z.

kyle: smoke (23:36 UTC) — run summary:
- 1k QPS for 5m -> p95 210ms, p50 22ms
- GPU util avg 62% (no OOMs)
- evictions_per_min = 0.6
- allocator logs show expected rebalances, no errors

jen: LGTM from PR author side. thanks for quick smoke.

maria: green from me. leave in place. we'll do a 04:30 UTC quick sanity and then revisit tomorrow morning.

liam: noted, I'll keep pager window open for next 2 hours.

kyle: rolling log excerpt (for audit):
```
2026-03-18T23:30:05Z applied-policy v=aurora policy=aurora-slice-v2
2026-03-18T23:31:10Z pod/aurora-1 scaled down from 2->1
2026-03-18T23:33:40Z alloc/rebalance completed slice=aurora
```

maria: excellent. closing thread once we do the 04:30 sanity. thanks everyone. :party_parrot:
